instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace 'Sparkcurve' with 'Sparkcurv' everywhere, including the Logo text in the Sidebar and LoginPage.
2. Update LoginPage.jsx: Apply the split layout defined in layouts.login_page. Use the provided architectural image in the right panel with a heavy multiply blend mode using the #002FA7 color.
3. Update index.css to map existing component classes (e.g., .nav-item, .metric-card, .table-row) to the new Tailwind utility classes provided in component_guidelines.
4. Add padding inside cards to prevent text collision. Use p-6 generally for metric-cards.
5. Ensure all data tables have generous horizontal padding (px-6) and vertical padding (py-4) in table-cell to fix alignment issues.
6. Improve form layouts in the forgotten password dialog: stack labels above inputs, use proper gap-4 spacing.
7. For the Time Tracker, use JetBrains Mono for the actual timer text to prevent layout shifting during countdowns.

login_background.description: Modern glass architecture. Use as the background for the right panel of the Login Page with a multiply blend mode overlay of the primary blue color.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute for automated testing.
Do NOT add inline styles. Rely on Tailwind CSS via the mapped classes.
Do not apply global transitions like 'transition: all' which can break transforms.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns to preserve text contrast.
Keep standard HTML structure unchanged where it affects functionality (e.g., map views, specific charting containers).
